explanations.trigger_explanation: Excavation or utility cut work in Austin public right of way commonly triggers a city right-of-way excavation permit and related right-of-way management controls.

known_unknowns: Some projects also need contractor licensing, bonding, insurance, traffic control approvals, and Austin Utility Location and Coordination Committee review.
advisories: Additional review recommended for staging, traffic control, bonding, and dry-utility repair work because those implementation details are handled within Austin's right-of-way permit system.
notes: Confidence tier 2 because the permit path is clearly published by the City of Austin, but permit packaging can vary with work type and right-of-way conditions.
